name: Takaishi Misaki
source:
[Female successor candidate]

She is the figurehead CEO of "L'ange", an underwear manufacturer under the Sonoda Group.

She is the youngest and only woman among the candidates for CEO.

She has a gentle personality, is naive, and is also a bit of an airhead.
The reason she became CEO is not because she is an excellent representative, but because she is beautiful and can be used as a poster girl, and the company used her for its own convenience.

On the other hand, she has a genius-level sense of design, and is talented enough to make Misaki's works the cutting edge of fashion.

As a successor candidate, the Sonoda family noticed her achievements among the companies in the Sonoda Group, and she is a person who is ignorant of the world and easy to use, and so they chose her as a candidate.
(As an insurance in case Yuri does not want to become a successor)

She was supported by those around her, and she herself became interested, so she ran as a participant without much thought.
